card.name: Commas and 'or' in cardiovascular outcome lists
card.fires_on: Commas, 'or', 'and' and 'of' that join items in lists of cardiovascular outcomes such as MI, stroke, death and heart failure hospitalization, in trial endpoint text.

modes.label: List separators
modes.description: A comma or 'or'/'and' right after an event like stroke or CHF in a composite endpoint list.
modes.example: All-cause mortality, MI, hospitalization for CHF,<< or>> stroke All-cause mortality, MI,

modes.label: Incidence phrase
modes.description: The word 'of' after 'incidence' before a cardiac event name.
modes.example: The incidence<< of>> atrial fibrillation was greater in patients

card.plain: It fires on the commas and 'or' that link heart attack, stroke and death in lists of trial outcomes.
